fields.subject: SpanParser
fields.condition: GetDbGrainId has not previously cached a grain-id-building delegate for the model's runtime type
fields.trigger: a caller invokes GetDbGrainId with a non-null model
fields.response: compile the grain-id-building delegate for that model type via OrleansExpressionHelper.BuildGrainIdFromDbModel, cache it keyed by the model's runtime type, and invoke it to produce the returned IdSpan
fields.postcondition: a later GetDbGrainId call for the same model type reuses the cached delegate instead of recompiling it
